task.summary:
feat(app): add auto-login and improve server/user management (master)
- Implement auto-login with last connected user - Add last_connected_user_id to Config, with set/clear methods - Update active_server handling and saving in state - Refactor AppLayout/AppSidebar to allow logout logic - Sidebar now provides logout button to clear user and return to selection - Clean up unused .idea files and update vcs.xml - Add .idea/workspace.xml for IDE configuration
Update `.idea` config: include additional source folders and enable default features for crates
Update `.idea` config: refine change list and task updates
Switch `.idea` build profile to test, add integration test configuration
